mapping.businessReality: Company business lines, maturity, domain scenarios, and go/no-go decisions
mapping.oamEntry: Business Line Registry and Business Domain Kit
mapping.runtimeBoundary: Domain packs define semantics; Operations Runtime owns execution; current-state blocks production.

mapping.businessReality: Subjects, vehicles, formal relationships, master receipts, and master summaries
mapping.runtimeBoundary: Domain packs may submit intake only; shared governance owns center truth.

mapping.businessReality: Who may commit each center truth fact and which references are provisional or receipt-only
mapping.oamEntry: Truth owner registry and fact ownership rules
mapping.runtimeBoundary: Only declared owners commit facts; projection/search/management cockpit cannot become owners.

mapping.businessReality: Money, deposits, payments, correction, ledger transactions, and finance receipts
mapping.runtimeBoundary: MoneyBasis routes through finance truth before balanced ledger commit; domain pages do not confirm finance facts directly.

mapping.businessReality: Events, state transitions, summaries, projection commits, and traceability
mapping.runtimeBoundary: Operations confirm appends facts; read-side summaries must trace to committed source events.

mapping.businessReality: BI, KPI, metric lineage, operating feedback, and management dashboards
mapping.oamEntry: BI/KPI contract, metric formulas, and operating feedback loop
mapping.runtimeBoundary: Dashboards are read-only; metric deviations route through feedback/control plane evidence.

mapping.businessReality: Accounts, actors, devices, application/API boundary, permissions, and cutover policy
mapping.oamEntry: Actor/Device admission, permission policy, cutover policy, and API boundary
mapping.runtimeBoundary: Admission resolves actor/device/business-line/release-state; application surfaces cannot override confirm or production.
